annotations.title: Is this claim already taken by a competitor?

description: Use when the user is choosing a positioning, a tagline or a message and asks whether competitors already say it, whether a claim is crowded or open, or who has moved onto it recently. Reads each competitor's home page today and its Internet Archive copy from a year ago, and returns, per site, whether it leads with the claim, mentions it, or does not, and whether that changed this year, with a verdict: open, mentioned but not owned, taken, or crowded. No page text is returned. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: today against a year ago; compare: sites (3-5 competitors); segment: variants (wordings of the claim). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For whether people search for that reason to buy, use run_angle_demand. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/claim-check.json
